tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the header, dialogs, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Sunken areas: filter panel, table header rows, hover fill on list rows, skeletons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox outlines: 3:1 on surface-1 and surface-0 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (meta lines, captions, placeholders) on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Deep-water navy: the header bar, the map cluster bubbles, the footer band.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Teal: primary buttons, links, active navigation, map markers, selected filters.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills; link hover.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected chips, active list row, tinted info areas that belong to the brand.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-strong fills.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus ring on every interactive element; 3:1 on all surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-inverse
tokens.usage: Focus ring on brand surfaces (header, footer band): 3:1 on brand in both themes.

tokens.name: rating
tokens.usage: Filled rating stars and the average-rating number's star. Always next to the numeric value.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Text and icon for approved, verified and achieved states, on surface-1 or success-soft. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and banners.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Text and icon for pending states and minor site warnings, on surface-1 or caution-soft.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Background of caution badges and the site-warning banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Text and icon for errors, rejected states, serious hazards and destructive actions, on surface-1 or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error banners, rejected badges and the hazard warning banner.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Text and icon for neutral notices (the safety disclaimer, empty states), on surface-1 or info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info banners and the disclaimer box on the site page.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and the mobile navigation drawer.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page at most: the home hero and the profile name.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles: site name, feed title, form titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: A deep sinkhole with an arch at 55 m.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense lists, meta lines, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons, tabs, navigation items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, chart axes, map attribution. Never for sentences.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Coordinates, depths, temperatures and other measured values.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; chip gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input and button horizontal padding; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap above major page sections and the footer.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, badges, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, banners, map popups.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, the map frame, hero images.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, pill toggles, the map cluster bubble.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards and the sticky header.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Map popups, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Height of the app header bar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content (site page, feed, profile).

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: Max width of long text: post body, review form.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Map page filter and results panel on desktop.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: below it the layout is single-column and the navigation collapses into a drawer.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: from it the map page shows the side panel next to the map.
